sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: After a winding-up order, the Tribunal has jurisdiction to entertain, or dispose of, any suit or proceeding by or against the company, and any claim made by or against it.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: The jurisdiction concentrates disputes in the Tribunal. It does not remove a criminal court's jurisdiction. Questions of priority among creditors are decided in the liquidation.
